verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee offers AI-powered semantic extraction from scraped pages (`ai_query`, `ai_extract_rules`) and proxied ChatGPT/Gemini endpoints. So users can ask AI questions about web content they scrape, but this is extraction or Q&A via API calls, not in-product insights or suggestions generated from the user's own data. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis of the user's accumulated data, proactive suggestions, an in-product (non-API) insights surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AI quality.
